title: baissea subsessilis
intro: Baissea subsessilis, commonly known as "Lianthusa", is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant activities. The therapeutic actions of Baissea subsessilis include wound healing, pain relief, and antiseptic properties, making it a potential treatment for skin conditions and infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
